{"metadata":{"description":"Composer mic for DeepSeek Harness Web: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.","id":"gh:1335271508","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-voice-input-plugin","slug":"Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Composer mic for DeepSeek Harness Web: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-t"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"TS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-client-ui-voice-input"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Composer **voice control** for DeepSeek Harness: a minimal linear mic button in the composer tool ro"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"w that turns your speech into text — with a **tap-to-monitor** mode (continuous, live 逐字 streaming, "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"send-anytime) and a **hold-to-talk** voice-chat mode (release to send, reply read aloud). Zero API k"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"ey: recognition runs in the browser via the Web Speech API; reply reading uses the host's Edge TTS ("},{"id":"p3s5","text":"`/api/tts`) with a browser `speechSynthesis` fallback."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-plugin` · TypeScript · React"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Tap to monitor**: click the mic, speak — text streams into the draft live (逐字输入), the mic keeps "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"listening even in silence, and you can send or keep adding speech anytime. Tap again to stop.
- **Au"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"to-send on silence** *(optional)*: with `autoSendOnSilenceMs` configured, tap-to-monitor becomes han"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ds-free — once you stop talking for the configured window, the message sends itself ("tap, speak, wa"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"lk away"). Continued speech cancels the pending send.
- **Hold to talk**: press-and-hold to record a"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" voice-chat message, release to send it; the assistant's reply is read aloud — host Edge neural TTS "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"(`/api/tts`) first, browser `speechSynthesis` as fallback.
- **Continuous across silences**: each re"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"cognition segment auto-restarts so monitoring never drops.
- **Respects the composer**: speech appen"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ds to the draft (base preserved); a send clears the draft cleanly without re-filling old text; monit"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"oring continues after a send on a fresh recognizer.
- **DeepSeek-blue listening state**: the icon pu"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"lses in DeepSeek brand blue while listening; borderless linear icon, no clutter.
- **Configurable**:"},{"id":"p6s12","text":" recognition language (default `zh-CN`) and interim results."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The package is a `dsh.bundle` installable, published on npm as `@zhangbo-cn/dsh-client-ui-voice-inpu"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" `dsh.bundle` installable, published on npm as `@zhangbo-cn/dsh-client-ui-voice-input`. One command:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **0.1.1+ required.** `0.1.0` registered the browser bundle under the wrong ModuleLoader id (`@deep"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"seek-ai/...`), so Harness failed with `loaded without registering "@zhangbo-cn/dsh-client-ui-voice-i"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"nput"`. Upgrade / reinstall, then hard-refresh the Web UI."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"(It also installs from the GitHub repo via `dsh plugin add github:Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin`"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"t also installs from the GitHub repo via `dsh plugin add github:Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin`.)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"If you develop from a DeepSeek Harness checkout, you can mount it directly in the web-app browser ro"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ster (`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For **reliable reply reading**, also mount the host Edge TTS capability (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tts-edge`"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"), which registers `/api/tts`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Without it, reply reading still works but falls back to the browser's `speechSynthesis` (less natura"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"l, occasionally silent on Chrome after an idle gap)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then build the client bundle with the repo's tsdown preset:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"After refreshing the Web UI, the composer tool row shows a linear mic button."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Voice input (tap)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. **Click** the mic → the icon turns DeepSeek blue and pulses (listening).
2. **Speak** → text appe"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ars in the input box live, word by word.
3. Send anytime with the composer's send button; keep talki"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ng to add more.
4. **Click the mic again** to stop monitoring.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Recognition starts on pointer-down (a user gesture — required by the Web Speech API); tap vs hold "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"is decided on release.
- The same pointer-down gesture unlocks reply audio (a shared `AudioContext` "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"is resumed), so the assistant's reply — which arrives seconds later — is exempt from the browser aut"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"oplay policy that would otherwise block a plain `HTMLMediaElement.play()`.
- **Reply reading streams"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"**: complete sentences are read aloud while the model is still generating (a sentence-chunked queue,"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" flushed at ~30 chars for delimiter-less runs); the last incomplete sentence is read on finalize. Th"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"e mic icon pulses deep blue while reading, and **tapping the mic stops the reading**.
- **No speaker"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"-echo**: while the reply is being read, recognition is paused (the mic physically picks up the speak"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"er), then resumes when reading finishes if monitoring was on.
- `continuous: false` per segment is i"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"ntentional: Chrome's `continuous: true` fails to deliver `onresult`, so monitoring is achieved by au"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"to-restarting segments.
- The append base resets when the draft changes externally, so a send never "},{"id":"p25s12","text":"lets stale voice text re-fill the box.
- The console logs `[dsh-voice]` diagnostics for each read se"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"gment and any fallback."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Browser | Mic (input, SpeechRecognition) | Reply playback (host `/api/tts`, fallback `speechSynthe"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"er | Mic (input, SpeechRecognition) | Reply playback (host `/api/tts`, fallback `speechSynthesis`) |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Chrome / Edge (Windows) | ✅ Web Speech | ✅ host Edge neural MP3; browser `speechSynthesis` fallbac"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"k |
| Safari | ✅ webkitSpeechRecognition (re-trigger on each gesture) | ✅ host Edge neural MP3 (play"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"able); browser fallback works |
| Firefox | ⚠️ **not supported — browser limitation** (Mozilla has n"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ot shipped `SpeechRecognition`; local on-device recognition is still early-stage) | ✅ host Edge neur"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"al MP3 (playable); `speechSynthesis` fallback supported but less natural |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Notes:
- **Firefox mic input**: this is a genuine browser limitation, not a plugin issue. The plugin"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" feature-detects and disables the mic with a "not supported in this browser" hint. A cross-browser f"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"allback would need `MediaRecorder` + an external transcription service (out of scope for a zero-back"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"end plugin).
- **Reply playback**: the preferred path is the host's `/api/tts` (Microsoft Edge neura"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"l voices, synthesized server-side) — reliable and natural on every browser that can play MP3. Withou"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"t the `tts-edge` host plugin, the client falls back to `speechSynthesis` (Chrome may silently drop `"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"speak()` after an idle gap; voices are OS-default).
- Mic input requires a browser with Web Speech; "},{"id":"p29s8","text":"reply playback requires either the `tts-edge` host plugin or a browser with `speechSynthesis`."}],"truncated":true}
